title: Desire
medium: Engraved 57 mm brass artillery shell (tuned to F5 at 685.76 Hz), stainless steel cable with attached wooden clapper, pounded brass artillery shells, brass

said.q: the power to take something that was meant for destruction, harm, and change it to something that has the possibility to heal.
The sculpture Desire is a hanging mobile made of engraved and pounded brass artillery shells. From the top an engraved shell casing is suspended, its surface patterned with snake scales.

events.n: material: artillery shells salvaged in Vietnam
events.q: The work belongs to Nguyen's series of mobiles made from artillery shells salvaged in Vietnam

events.t: Tuan Andrew Nguyen, Fire Sermon, Esther Schipper, Berlin
